'''Squires''' were apprentice [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] in the culture of the [[Serp]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]]. Once his training was complete, a squire became a [[Knight (warrior)|knight]].
